verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows extensive static code snippets across Cloudflare's Sandbox docs (exec, file I/O, sessions, interpreter, etc.) but nothing indicates an interactive, in-browser 'try it now' API reference or runnable playground — the openapi.json probe is for Cloudflare's general API, not a Sandbox-specific interactive explorer. Missing for 10: an in-page runnable code sandbox/playground, an interactive API explorer (e.g., Swagger/Redoc try-it-out), or any embedded live execution environment tied to the docs.
